jobs.title: Martech Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

### **About the role**

The Martech Operations Lead is the product owner and project lead for IDMe's Martech stack, including its tools and processes. You support both consumer (B2C) and business-to-business (B2B) marketing, turn Marketing's needs into clear requirements, sequence the work against agreed priorities, and drive delivery. You make sure the data Marketing collects is accurate, consistent and ready for campaign measurement, modeling and reporting.

You are responsible for the Martech platforms between data collection and the channels where marketers act, including the customer data platform and its audiences, lifecycle messaging, B2B automation and account-based marketing, paid and brand platforms, consent and preference tools, and marketing data integration. You work closely with the teams that own the surrounding layers: product surfaces and event collection, the data warehouse and models, Revenue Operations (which owns Salesforce), and reporting.

* **Privacy, preferences and consent**. Make sure every Martech operation meets GDPR, CCPA, FedRAMP and IDMe's own privacy and data governance standards. * **Recommendations and enablement**. Recommend new platforms and enhancements, including AI features, and lead the technical evaluation. The Director makes the decision. Train Marketing teams to use the platforms well, and mentor colleagues and specialists on platform best practices.

jobs.title: EverHealth - Customer Success Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

  
  

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

  
  

**EverHealth,** a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.

  
  

We are looking for a **Customer Success Manager** you have a strong service delivery project and program management background with deep expertise in healthcare related service delivery. You love establishing best in class service delivery methodologies, standards, tools and processes to ensure that our products are delivered to our customers effectively and efficiently, assuring delivery on time with strong adoption/engagement.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Be a great facilitator and problem solver building relationships internally and externally, focused around enabling customer growth, satisfaction, and product loyalty.

* Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders of our customers ensuring the best possible customer experience.

* Monitor customer’s usage of product(s) and services helping grow monthly recurring revenue by driving adoption and identifying new upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

* Develop individual success plans for each customer to ensure adoption, expansion, and loyalty across your portfolio.

* Be an expert on the EverHealth Platforms maintaining a deep understanding of our technology and products.

* Have general knowledge of our EverHealth portfolio of products and how they add values to our customers.

Understand customer needs and identify and share best product workflows that help them close process gaps and improve success metrics.  

  

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred

* 2-4 years relevant service/relationship management experience

* Prior SaaS account management experience highly desired, healthcare industry experience is a plus.

* Experience handling multiple tasks required.

* A willingness to take initiative and solve problems.

* An orientation toward constantly improving processes and management best practices.

* A willingness to share with the team practices at your prior companies that helped create great customer experiences.
  

  

**Where:**

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

  
  

**Benefits and Perks**

* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
* Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program

  

**Compensation:**

The On Target Earnings (base + commission) for this position is $65,000 to $75,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. ,000 - $70,000 USD and variable component included in most US locatio

  
  

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

  
  

EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

As a key member of the Global Account Management Core team, the Account Manager will be responsible for account profitability, service delivery, implementations, and customer satisfaction. The Account Manager works with Direct Travel's corporate accounts to improve efficiencies, create and administer travel policies, evaluate and implement technologies, and troubleshoot issues.

This is a fully remote position with ~20% travel.

**Responsibilities**

Manage all aspects of the relationship between Direct Travel and a portfolio of global corporate clients including but not limited to:

* Client retention
* Implement a Global Business Plan to establish, achieve and measure the business objectives of the global travel program
* Managing all existing client contract terms including
  + Negotiations for contract renewals or extensions and amendments
  + The leadership and management of RFI/RFP process
* Participating and taking a lead role in the implementation of global accounts
* Identify business consolidation and growth opportunities
* The ability to effectively sell additional value-added products and services
* Proactive management of the client's profitability
* Conducting business reviews quarterly or bi-annually
* Develop an understanding of client business models, goals, and business needs in order to understand how Direct Travel programs can be part of their solutions.
* Lead a strategic account planning process with clients and develop a business plan which defines and tracks mutually agreed upon performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones.
* The ability to interpret data and make recommendations based on findings to improve program goals and objectives.
* Ensure that account performance objectives and client expectations are continually met - collaborating with internal departments, external suppliers and global partners where required to find solutions
* Capturing all relevant client-related data and opportunities in CRM
* Consistently uphold the company's vision and values while ensuring the customer experience is in focus.
* Ensure high service levels for all customers and work with Direct Travel ATPI Operations teams globally to resolve service-related concerns
* Distribute travel communications to keep customers apprised of industry developments
* Strong knowledge of industry trends and issues, and an understanding of how these impact on the business environment
* Demonstrated ability to influence corporate client decisions
* Ability to think strategically, and manage and align inter-organizational expectations
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on innovative and creative solutions
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, or efforts associated with the position.

**Basic Qualifications**

* The candidate must possess a Bachelor's degree and 8 years corporate travel account management experience or equivalent experience.
* A minimum of 5 years managing global customer portfolios, working with wholly owned and partner agencies.
* The ability to participate in calls/meetings outside of normal business hours to support the program management
* Demonstrate thorough knowledge of the business travel industry, airline and hospitality industries, and travel industry-specific automation
* Possess intermediate to advanced MS Office skills (i.e. MS Word, Excel, One Note and Powerpoint)
* Able to successfully manage multiple tasks simultaneously; speak, read, and write English; possess excellent customer service, interpersonal, negotiating and verbal/written communications skills
* Conduct complex interpersonal interactions with others, troubleshoot, solve problems, make decisions, operate independently, and work effectively under pressure on a regular basis
* Excellent relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, interpersonal)
* Excellent presentation and meeting facilitation skills
* Must be able to lawfully work within the US and have unrestricted work authorization for US

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A minimum of 15 years corporate account management experience
* A minimum of 8 years managing global customer portfolios, working with wholly owned and partner agencies.
* SalesForce CRM experience an asset

**Benefits Onboard**

In addition to Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits Direct Travel offers a Total Rewards Package which includes Retirement Plans, Wellness, Rewards and Recognition, Sustainability, DE&I initiatives, and Mental Health Support.

**About Direct Travel**

Direct Travel is one of the world's largest travel management companies. With a long history of proven market expertise, we blend advanced technology, superior service, and expert insight to drive tangible value and meaningful savings across Corporate Travel, Leisure Travel, Meetings & Events and specialty travel businesses. Through Avenir, our intelligent travel management platform, we reduce obstacles and give clients more direct access to content, trusted data, intelligence and global expertise. What truly sets us apart is the human care behind the technology, delivered by an experienced, passionate team dedicated to anticipating needs and delivering exceptional service at every step. For more information about Direct Travel, visit www.dt.com

Direct Travel is an equal opportunity employer

### **Essential Duties**

* Lead a team of Sales Operations Support Specialists which supports NRI’s Account Executives by providing client-facing quotes, booking orders, and addressing post-sales requests as appropriate.
* Coach Sales Operations Support Specialists on NRI and partner business processes and answer day to day questions
* Distribute incoming requests in service request management system, ensuring appropriate and efficient division of labor, meeting service level agreements (SLAs)
* Provide occasional overflow support as necessary.
* Proactively review and escalate aging requests to ensure SLA compliance.
* Coordinate time off requests and coverage for team members, ensuring adequate coverage for business operations.
* Ensure new orders are booking accurately and based on complete required information according to NRI standard business processes, and according to SLAs.
* Coordinate month end booking process, ensuring that all targeted orders are booked on time.
* Address initial escalation requests from internal and external clients including Sales, Application Solution and Design (presales engineering), and Finance teams, both for old business and new business
* Assist Sales Operations Support Specialists in directing out of scope requests to appropriate Core or partner teams to ensure requests are addressed.
* Understand the industry environment.
* Attend both internal and external meetings as needed (typically via Microsoft Teams or Cisco Webex with camera on)
* Participate in online training sessions provided by our key partners as appropriate.
* Represent and deliver on NRI goals, mission and values.
* Continually looking for ways to maximize efficiency and better meet the needs of our clients, recommending process improvements and assisting in change management activities associated with business process changes that impact the team.

### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of leadership experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comprehensive understanding of standard quote to cash business processes.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, and service request management systems (Zendesk, ServiceNow, etc.)
* Process Expert: Strong process management skills and financial acumen.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* 5+ years of experience with quote-to-cash workflow for consulting services, managed services, software as a service (SaaS), and infrastructure solutions.
* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint).

$80,000 - $92,000 a year

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary bonus plan based on company and individual performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each candidate, including experience and location.

You'll love working at NRI not just for the usual benefits, but for our environment and culture!

We provide a comprehensive benefits program including: Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance, Life Insurance, Health/Dependent Care Flexible Spending, 401(k) Plan, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage, Generous Vacation and Flex Time Off Programs, Company Paid Holidays, and Training and Development Opportunities.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional **Legal Operations Manager.**

**About RainFocus:**

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly-growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Cisco, Oracle, Gartner, and VMware to prepare and execute events, each with tens of thousands of attendees, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing teams. We are well-funded, growing fast, taking on an established industry leader, and building a company that is changing the market—it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

**About the Role:**

The Legal Operations Manager serves as the central operational hub bridging Legal, Procurement, Privacy, and Information Security. Reporting directly to the VP of Legal & Corporate Services, this role blends substantive paralegal capability with end-to-end vendor procurement lifecycle management and contract portfolio administration.

In this role, you will take ownership of the company's agreement ecosystem, with a heavy operational focus on vendor procurement, SaaS contracts, and third-party supplier agreements, alongside client MSAs, Partner Agreements, and NDAs. You will work closely on a day-to-day basis with our Business Systems and Information Security teams to route, audit, and secure all required documentation—including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), security exhibits, system integrations, and compliance paperwork. Further, you will serve as a trusted second set of eyes: autonomously redlining standard agreements against playbooks, tracking renewal pipelines, flagging risk and liability outliers, managing insurance documentation, and acting as an operational extension of the team to ensure seamless continuity across all corporate legal workflows.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Procurement & Vendor Contract Management**

* Vendor Lifecycle Administration: Own the operational workflow for new and existing vendor engagements, with heavy emphasis on SaaS, professional services, software licenses, and IT infrastructure agreements.
* Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Systems to align software license terms, seat counts, and integration requirements, and collaborate with Information Security to ensure required security exhibits, SOC reports, and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) are fully vetted and executed.
* Renewal & Expiration Management: Build and maintain an active renewal calendar for all vendor and SaaS agreements. Issue proactive alerts to internal business owners well in advance of auto-renewal, price escalation, and notice-of-non-renewal deadlines.
* Vendor Offboarding Governance: Lead formal contract offboarding when vendors are decommissioned, ensuring notices of termination are delivered, auto-renewals are halted, and data destruction/transition provisions are verified alongside Security and IT.

**Legal Support, Redlining & Departmental Backfill**

* Autonomous NDA Negotiation: Review, redline, and finalize inbound and outbound Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) using established company playbooks and approved fallback positions.
* VP & Operational Coverage: Serve as the primary triage point for operational legal inquiries; keep routine contracting matters, standard amendments, and internal approvals moving forward seamlessly.
* DocuSign Administration & Signature Routing: Serve as the primary DocuSign administrator across the company; configure signature workflows, build and maintain reusable templates, enforce proper routing hierarchies, and ensure complete execution and audit trails for all corporate documents.
* Playbook & Intake Optimization: Maintain and refine standard legal intake procedures, review checklists, and standard clause libraries to streamline internal handoffs between Legal, Procurement, and Security.
* Event & Vendor COI Management: Request, review, submit, and maintain event Certificates of Insurance (COIs) required by venues for corporate onsite events; collect and verify COIs and endorsement forms from third-party contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with policy limits.

**Contract Auditing, Repository Ownership & Querying**

* Central Repository Ownership: Ingest, organize, tag, and audit 100% of executed agreements across the company (vendor, client, partner, contractor, and corporate leases) in the central contract management system.
* Substantive Risk Querying: Query and analyze historical and incoming contracts to generate actionable reports on key legal and business terms, such as limitation of liability caps, indemnities, service level agreements (SLAs), governing law, and outlier provisions.
* Internal Stakeholder Reporting: Produce recurring status dashboards for executive leadership detailing active contract pipelines, upcoming renewal exposures, and vendor spend commitments.

### **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Experience: 2–5+ years of experience in an in-house corporate legal department, working as a corporate paralegal, contracts manager, or legal operations specialist with substantial procurement involvement.

* Legal & Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to read, analyze, and spot issues in commercial terms across SaaS agreements, MSAs, and NDAs (e.g., limitation of liability, indemnification, termination rights, data ownership, IP).

* Cross-Functional Proficiency: Demonstrated success collaborating directly with Information Security (handling DPAs, security riders) and Business Systems/IT teams (handling SaaS licensing and software terms).

* Technical Skills: Proficiency with DocuSign (Admin level), Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, Google Sheets/Microsoft Excel (for structured data analysis and querying), and workflow systems (Jira, Salesforce, or Asana).

**Position Title: GGU One Contact Center Operations Manager**

**Department Name: Office of the Provost**

**Days & Hours:** Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week, generally 9am – 5:30pm PST but can be adjusted and/or staggered to support team coverage across the team’s coverage window; flexible schedule may require some evening and weekend hours during peak periods or to handle escalations.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE OF JOB:**

Build, stabilize, and lead GGU One’s student support operation. Manage the Navigator team (Navigators are Golden Gate University’s first contact for all student inquiries), establish dependable coverage and follow-up, improve service quality, and lead implementation of the agreed operating model and roadmap in partnership with university departments and IT.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Hire, onboard, supervise, coach, and evaluate the GGU One Navigator team. Establish clear responsibilities and ongoing training.

Evaluate opportunities to improve student support through AI, self-service, and additional channels such as chat and text, prioritizing student needs, service quality, and operational readiness.
* **Case Ownership & Tier 2 Follow-Through:** Establish clear ownership, response expectations, and escalation procedures with university departments. Monitor unresolved and overdue inquiries, address stalled handoffs, and ensure students receive updates through resolution.
* **Knowledge & Guidance:** Coordinate with departmental subject-matter experts to maintain accurate, approved Navigator resources. Establish content owners and a process for addressing gaps, conflicting guidance, and policy changes.
* **Quality Assurance & Training:** Review call recordings, email interactions, and case documentation. Provide timely coaching and targeted training on accuracy, empathy, identity verification, escalation, and follow-up.

Define operational requirements, lead user testing, and prepare the team to adopt new workflows, while technical teams own system configuration and integrations.
* **Reporting & Capacity Planning:** Produce regular reporting on demand, answering, callbacks, resolution, unresolved work, and quality. Validate metric definitions and data accuracy and recommend staffing adjustments as demand and service scope evolve.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Higher Education, or any other related field from an accredited college or university.
* **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of relevant service-operations experience, including direct supervision of a customer support, contact center, or higher education student-services team.

* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Ability to establish accountability, establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and resolve student service issues across departments, including teams outside the role’s direct reporting line.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working knowledge of CRM and contact-center tools (ideally Salesforce Education Cloud/Service Cloud), with experience partnering with IT/technical teams on operational implementations.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Higher-education student-services experience, familiarity with FERPA regulations, and knowledge of military-connected and veteran student needs are strongly preferred.
* **Skills and Abilities:**
  + Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  + Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle difficult or emotional clients, and manage a busy, high-stakes service department.
  + Proven experience leading a diverse team with varied expertise, including coaching, training, and employee development.
  + Ability to compile and synthesize data from multiple sources into reports and presentations for leadership.
  + Self-directed and able to work effectively with minimal supervision.

Supplemental Information

Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William & Mary.*

*Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.*

**About the role**
------------------

This role sits next to our Product Manager and inside the Engineering team. You'll own the operational side of how we plan, ship, and report on work: the cycle cadence, ticket hygiene, release coordination, and cross-functional program management across product, engineering, ML, and CS.

This is a hands-on, proactive operating role. You're the person a fast-moving engineering team routes through. You keep the work moving without waiting to be asked, and you make the way the team works a little better every cycle.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Cycle operations**

* Run the team's three-week cycle cadence, including kickoff, daily standups, scope check-ins, demos, and retrospectives

### **Ticket hygiene**

* Maintain high-quality tickets with clear acceptance criteria and correct prioritization
* Ensure work is properly structured (parents, dependencies, scope)
* Identify and clean up orphaned, duplicate, or stale tickets
* Push back on stories that are not ready for development

### **Cross-functional program management**

* Coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams, including Product, Engineering, ML, and Customer Success
* Manage dependencies across areas such as integrations, data pipelines, and customer readiness
* Act as the connective tissue to keep projects moving forward
* Route incoming requests to the right place (on-call, a small-fixes queue, or a future cycle) so work doesn't get assigned through DMs

### **Release coordination**

* Track what is included in each release
* Draft release notes and communicate updates clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with Customer Success to prepare for customer-facing changes
* Keep teams informed without creating unnecessary noise

### **Process improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows
* Propose and implement practical improvements
* Continuously evolve team processes rather than simply maintaining them
* Run the team's written playbook from day one, and take ownership of it once you've run a full cycle

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

#### **Experience**

4+ years as a project manager, technical program manager, or scrum master in a software organization.

#### **Working style**

* Comfortable in an engineering room. You can follow a technical debate without needing translation.
* Not afraid to push back when a senior dev says “just trust me.”
* You care about the craft of project management more than the title.
* You have opinions about how teams should work, but aren't dogmatic. Methodology is a tool, not a rulebook.
* You'd rather build a useful spreadsheet than implement a heavy framework.
* Comfortable being the only PM in a room of engineers.
* You're the hub. The team routes through you, so you're reachable and responsive during core hours, and you protect focus time without becoming hard to find.
* You finish what you pick up, completely and correctly, without needing someone to check on it.

#### **Mindset**

* Strong written communication. A lot of our work happens asynchronously and in writing.
* Comfort with ambiguity. We have a written process, and it changes every time we learn something. You'll run it and make it better.
* You care about where the work lands. The dollars our product helps move go to university scholarships, hospital research, and food banks, and that should matter to you.
* Curious about AI as a product surface, not just a hype cycle.
* Excited by building infrastructure from scratch instead of inheriting something polished.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, or B2B Sa

Service Delivery Manager

Location: USA, Remote

**Position Overview**

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for managing the successful delivery, deployment, and activation of Nile's networking solutions across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.

This role serves as the primary technical project manager, coordinating internal engineering teams, deployment resources, third-party partners, logistics, and customer stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with Nile's delivery standards.

The SDM owns the customer deployment experience from project initiation through implementation, activation, stabilization, and formal handoff to the Customer Success organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management capabilities with technical networking knowledge, customer-facing leadership, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Service Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery execution for assigned customer deployments, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and according to established quality standards.
* Lead customer onboarding and deployment activities from project kickoff through implementation, activation, and operational handoff.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and communication across all delivery workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and potential blockers, implementing mitigation plans before they impact customer outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deployments across different geographies and levels of complexity.

**2. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the deployment and implementation lifecycle.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, technical workshops, and executive-level project updates.
* Set clear customer expectations around timelines, responsibilities, prerequisites, and deployment scope.
* Build strong relationships with customer IT leadership, project managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proactively manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution in collaboration with internal teams.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and consistent customer experience throughout the deployment journey.

**3. Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Service Engineering, Network Engineering, Product, Support, and Customer Success.
* Ensure appropriate technical discovery, design validation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) signoff before deployment execution.
* Work with Service Delivery Engineers (SDEs), deployment engineers, and external partners to coordinate implementation activities.
* Ensure alignment between pre-sales commitments and delivery execution.
* Drive effective collaboration between Day 0/Day 1 delivery teams and Day 2 Customer Success and Support teams.
* Identify organizational gaps and improve cross-functional processes to minimize handoff issues and operational friction.

**4. Deployment and Partner Management**

* Coordinate deployment resources, including field technicians, installation partners, cabling vendors, and logistics providers.
* Ensure deployment partners meet Nile's technical, operational, and customer experience standards.
* Validate site readiness, equipment availability, shipping schedules, installation requirements, and deployment prerequisites.
* Monitor partner performance, quality of work, productivity, and adherence to deployment schedules.
* Drive corrective actions when partner performance or deployment quality falls below expectations.
* Maintain consistent deployment processes and execution standards across regions.

**5. Operational Excellence and Process Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standardized deployment methodologies, project templates, delivery playbooks, and operational procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement across project execution, customer communications, resource utilization, and deployment efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve delivery visibility through tools such as Jira and Nile's internal platforms.
* Develop scalable delivery practices that support Nile's growing customer base and global NaaS business.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, deployment records, risk registers, and customer acceptance documentation.
* Drive lessons-learned reviews and incorporate feedback into future delivery improvements.

**6. Customer Handoff and Day 2 Readiness**

* Ensure all deployment activities are completed and validated before customer handoff.
* Coordinate operational transition from Service Delivery to Customer Success, Customer Support, and Technical Account Management teams.
* Ensure customer environments are properly documented, configured, tested, and ready for ongoing operations.
* Conduct handoff meetings covering network architecture, deployment status, known issues, open actions, and operational considerations.
* Ensure outstanding deployment issues are tracked with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
* Support early-life stabilization and hypercare activities to ensure a smooth transition into steady-state operations.

**7. Reporting, Governance, and Performance Management**

* Provide regular project and portfolio updates to Service Delivery leadership.
* Maintain visibility into project health, milestones, resource requirements, risks, and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
This position is primarily responsible for managing energy efficiency programs with high-level support from senior leadership. In this hands-on management role, you will oversee all aspects of an energy program and will work closely with both clients and our energy professionals to achieve client energy efficiency goals and other program objectives. This role will focus on learning all aspects of program management, financial acumen, and strategic direction. The Program Manager I is responsible for program budget oversight, team development and engagement, vendor and client relationships, and more.
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Actively engage in talent management process, including interviewing, resource planning and utilization, engagement planning, performance evaluations, and more
* Provide client communications and reporting
* Oversee program operations to ensure client requirements are met
* Seeks Senior Leadership support regarding developing and expanding client relationships
* Support partner and client contract management process
* Establish solid and trusted relationships with client program team
* Lead and support company-wide Safety efforts
* Orchestrate partnership and work between centralized functions and program staff
* Recognize when issues are occurring and seek assistance within program(s)
* Ensure successful delivery of program goals as indicated in Statement of Work

* Monitor and manage program budgets to ensure full utilization of funds while meeting or exceeding energy goals
* Prepare monthly invoices and activity reports as required to the client, partner or company management by the requested due date
* Managing one to two individually ran utility programs
* Report out on program performance and financial metrics
* Developing financial acumen and program strategy skillset
* Support Business Development with providing information on program re-bids, RFP, and client expansions.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  
Education and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s in science degree or equivalent required
* 2 or more years of management experience or 1 or more years of experience in managing energy efficiency programs
* Background in engineering, technology or science and experience in working in a technical environment – preferred
* Experience in lighting, HVAC, and other technologies installed applications – preferred
* Technical experience in developing and/or reviewing energy savings calculations to determine paybacks and incentive levels for customers – preferred

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Proven Leadership in fast paced environment
* Have an ability to prioritize workload and delegate appropriate work assignments to staff
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and written with customers, clients and employees
* Sales or business development background a plus
* Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems
* Committed to diversity and inclusion

Licenses & Certifications
  

* Project Management Professional (PMP)- preferred

* Willingness to travel up to 40%

**Compensation & Benefits:** Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $95,000 to $115,000 Annually. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company-sponsored benefits and programs.
  
  
**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike is a fast-growing cybersecurity company that protects customers from breaches. We are investing in project managers who are energetic, curious, and flexible, and who can run large, complex, cross-functional programs in a fast-paced environment. As a TechOps AI Project Manager, you will drive the initiatives that bring AI models and agentic development practices into how our technology organization builds, ships, and operates software. You will work across Engineering, Security, Data Science, Legal, and IT to make dependencies visible, surface critical issues early, and drive them to resolution.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Project Leadership:** Lead end-to-end execution of TechOps AI initiatives. These include onboarding and enabling AI models, coding assistants, and agent platforms, and rolling out agentic workflows across the SDLC (design, coding, code review, testing, release, and operations). Identify, track, and escalate critical issues until they are resolved.
* **AI Enablement Program Management:** Plan and coordinate model access, evaluation, and approval processes. This covers vendor and model onboarding, security and privacy reviews, usage policies, cost and capacity management, and tooling integration. Track adoption and outcome metrics such as usage, developer productivity, quality, and cost.
* **Communication and Coordination:** Align cross-functional teams and act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Translate fast-moving AI developments into clear plans, risks, and decisions. Own status reporting and communication for small to mid-size projects, and break down silos between engineering, security, and platform teams.
* **Change Management and Adoption:** Drive adoption of new AI-assisted and agentic ways of working. This means building champion networks, training and communication plans, feedback loops, and playbooks that help engineers adopt these tools with confidence and appropriate guardrails.
* **Process Improvement:** Thrive in an evolving, growing team and iterate often. Look for ways to improve program management processes, including applying AI and agents to PMO work such as planning, reporting, risk tracking, and dependency management.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Build strong relationships with internal teams and external partners, including AI model providers and tooling vendors. Provide regular, honest updates on progress, risks, and outcomes.

**What You'll Need:**

* **US Citizen or Green Card holder**

* 4+ years of program or project management experience, ideally in software engineering, technical operations, developer productivity, or platform organizations.
* Experience owning a program or portfolio of products or features: scoping requirements, planning milestones, and serving as an active resource for technical teams.
* Working knowledge of the modern SDLC (CI/CD, code review, testing, release management) and of how AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agents are changing it.
* Familiarity with core AI concepts: model selection and evaluation, prompt and context management, agent frameworks and tool use, and the cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs involved.
* Demonstrable experience with organizational change management and adoption, ideally rolling out new tools or ways of working to large engineering populations.
* Comfort navigating AI risk and governance topics, such as data handling, IP and licensing, model security, and responsible use, in partnership with Security, Legal, and Privacy teams.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders from individual engineers to senior leadership.
* A seasoned team player who works through persistent obstacles instead of avoiding them.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and to make logical, timely decisions with meticulous attention to detail.
* Enjoys consensus-driven environments built on collaboration and open, honest communication, and works effectively with global, cross-divisional teams.
* Self-directed learner who takes initiative as the AI landscape shifts.

**Bonus Points**

  

* PMI, Agile Alliance, or equivalent certification.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools or building with LLMs and agents, or experience running AI/ML platform or developer-experience programs.
* Experience with M&A and SaaS.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Project Manager
jobs.description:
At **People Science**, we’re reimagining clinical research for the modern world—making it more accessible, inclusive, and centered on real people. We're looking for a **Clinical Research Project Manager** who is passionate about health and wellness and ready to lead studies that go beyond traditional pharma. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a small team who is looking to empower humanity with the tools and knowledge of science and medicine to improve ourselves, our communities, and our world by making research tools accessible and understandable.

The People Science proprietary technology, Chloe (Consumer Health Learning & Organizing Ecosystem), is a consumer-friendly mobile app on the frontend, and a modular and configurable clinical research data management tool on the backend. It is designed for the purpose of engaging individual participants in the clinical research process from the comfort of their home by using their personal devices through active and passive data collection.

If you are looking to utilize your clinical research experience and project management experience, keep reading.

**Job Summary**   
At People Science, the Clinical Research Project Manager utilizes their depth of clinical research experience and project management skills to oversee all operational aspects of running clinical studies according to and in compliance with ICH, GCP, and other applicable documents and regulations. From protocol development through closeout, you’ll collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure our studies are run with precision, care, and integrity. You’ll manage timelines, coordinate with vendors and IRBs, and serve as the main point of contact for clients—all while helping us bring rigorous science to the wellness space. You'll work with our team of operations, product, technology, and marketing to ensure that the project and goals are achieved within timelines and budget.

**What You'll Be Doing**  
● End-to-end management of studies; initiates, plans, manages, and facilitates closeout of clinical research projects and ensures successful execution of the study

● Responsible for managing day-to-day operations of studies and projects, from protocol development to contract close, ensuring the study is conducted in compliance with applicable regulations, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and the study protocol

● Owns the sponsor/client relationship and ensures effective and timely communication (internally and externally) of study progress, issues, and plans for resolution

● Manages IRB/IEC communications and all vendor and/or external relationships associated with the study

● Develops the overall project plan and other associated documents for operationalizing the study, including scope, timelines, deliverables and other study details and workflow

● Collaborates with internal teams (product development, technology, marketing, and operations) and supervises members of the study team to ensure that study activities and operations are prepared and executed successfully

● Oversees and facilitates the development, configuration and implementation of the study in the CHLOE platform according the requirements and specifications of the study

● Identifies and organizes resources and services needed to accomplish tasks, sets objectives, and plans for contingencies

● Collaborates with internal team to develop recruitment and retention strategies

● Monitors, assesses, and tracks study status, progress, timelines, and expenditures

● Leads study meetings and reports on latest metrics, progress, and issues

● Understands and ensures compliance with SOPs, contract terms, and system requirements

● Responsible for the establishment and oversight of project specific training

● Participates in day-to-day Clinical Operations activities

**What You'll Bring**  
● Bachelor’s Degree, with a strong preference for a PhD

● 5+ years of experience in clinical research, including as a Clinical Research Coordinator

●3+ years of Project Management experience running multiple projects/studies at a time.

● Extensive knowledge of clinical research; understands the drug development process, knowledgeable about the critical elements for success in clinical trials, ability to review protocols and make assessments

● Deep knowledge of current ICH, GCP guidelines and clinical operations

● A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort in a startup-like environment

● Excellent organizational skills and follow through

● Excellent communication (oral and written) and presentation skills; ability to conduct effective presentations

● Demonstrates commitment to teamwork, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility in all areas of work

● **Computer skills** - Working knowledge of MS Office suite and Google applications. Willingness to gain expertise in the use of proprietary software.

*\*VISA Sponsorship is NOT Available for this position.*

We are a remote-first team, primarily based in the Los Angeles area. We have a preference for employees in the Southern California area to join for occasional in-person meetings. Anyone outside of that area may require occasional travel for meetings.

Salary will depend on various factors including applicant's prior relevant job experience, skill set, and geographic location. People Science offers a benefit package for full-time employees which includes: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Account, Life Insurance, DepCare FSA, Flexible Vacation Time Policy, Holidays, Retirement saving opportunity, and Employee Stock Options. People Science reserves the right to amend, change, alter, and revise pay ranges and benefits offerings at any time. It is at the Company's discretion to determine what pay is provided to a candidate within the range associated with the role.

www.peoplescience.health  
People Science is a direct-to-consumer scientific research company providing a scaled R&D platform for alternative medic

jobs.title: Business Operations Administrator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC**

Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country. Through the MaestroAuD® and MaestroFusion® product lines, Auris delivers clinical capacity and practice support that allow partner practices to serve more patients. Our team of remote audiologists and hearing care providers works in a growing number of states, and our operations must keep pace with that growth.

**Schedule:** Part-time, 15 to 20 hours per week

**Location:** Remote (United States)

**Classification:** W-2 Part-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt)

**Compensation:** $28 - $35 per hour, commensurate with experience

**Reports to:** Strategic Operations Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Business Operations Administrator manages core business operations for Auris, working closely with the Strategic Operations Manager and the Managing Members. This individual manages monthly customer invoicing in QuickBooks, administers partner agreements once a practice has decided to move forward, supports the partner launch team, coordinates onboarding and offboarding, and maintains Auris registrations in the states where its people work. The position supports the business side of the company and collaborates with the clinical team and other departments. The role suits a highly organized, detail-driven professional who works independently, handles confidential information with discretion, and takes ownership of deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operations Coordination Prepare and finalize business correspondence, agreements, and internal documents.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Track operational action items and deadlines and follow up to keep open items moving.
* Coordinate scheduling for partner, vendor, and internal meetings as requested.
* Maintain organized digital filing for finance, contracts, HR, and compliance records.

**Bookkeeping and Customer Invoicing**
--------------------------------------

* Prepare and send monthly invoices to partner practices in QuickBooks Online.
* Confirm that all consumables used during the month are added to each partner practice monthly invoice.
* Manage hearing aid fees due from partner practices to Auris, and confirm each fee is invoiced and collected.
* Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances.
* Record transactions, process vendor bills, and reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly.
* Collect W-9s from contractors and vendors, prepare year-end 1099 filings, and provide records to the outside CPA.

**Partner Contract Administration**
-----------------------------------

* Prepare partner agreements, schedules, and Business Associate Agreements from approved templates once a practice has decided to move forward.
* Manage the exchange of drafts and revisions with the practice, track open items, and escalate substantive changes to the Managing Members.
* Route final agreements for signature, file executed copies, and notify the launch team that the agreement is complete.
* Maintain a contract tracker with effective dates, renewal dates, and notice deadlines.

**Partner Launch Support**
--------------------------

* Complete assigned business-side launch tasks for new partner practices, including agreement completion, billing setup, and partner account records.
* Collect partner information and documents required for contracting and invoicing, and track business launch checklist items to completion.

**Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR Administration**
--------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate administrative onboarding and offboarding steps for employees and contractors, including agreements, equipment shipment and recovery, and system access requests.
* Update the professional liability carrier roster for provider additions and separations.
* Maintain confidential personnel and contractor files, and prepare employment verification letters.

**State Registration and Compliance**
-------------------------------------

* Register Auris as a foreign entity when a remote employee resides in a new state, and establish state withholding and unemployment insurance accounts.
* Maintain a compliance calendar of annual reports, registered agent renewals, and business license deadlines, and file on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Three or more years of experience in business operations, bookkeeping, or office management, preferably in a small or remote company.
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations and invoicing.
* Experience with contract administration and electronic signature platforms.
* Familiarity with state business registration and state tax account setup.
* Strong organization, accuracy, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.
* Proven discretion with confidential employee, financial, and health-related information.
* Clear, professional written communication.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a healthcare organization and familiarity with HIPAA.
* Experience with DocuSign, Rippling, and Microsoft 365.
* QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

**Work Environment**
====================

This is a fully remote position. The individual must maintain a private, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet and be available during standard business hours on a consistent weekly schedule. Hours may increase during partner launches and year-end close.

**How to Apply**
================

Submit your resume with 2-3 references, and a brief cover letter describing relevant operations, bookkeeping, and contract administration experience via the link above.

*Auris Practice Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.*

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
28 - 35 USD per hour(Remote)

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

TrueComp partners with over 1,000 public sector agencies to modernize workforce planning, compensation, and benefits analysis. Its intuitive platform and expert consulting empower HR and finance leaders with transparency, efficiency, and equity to make smarter decisions in recruitment, retention, and budgeting. TrueComp provides instant and actionable insights to help government organizations attract top talent, optimize labor strategies, and achieve long-term fiscal sustainability. Dedicated to simplifying workforce challenges, TrueComp’s solutions enable data-driven decisions that improve organizational performance and drive meaningful outcomes. TrueComp was recognized among the Top 100 Government Services companies on the 2024 Inc. 5000.

**About the role**

* The Customer Success Manager owns a book of 50-75 public agency accounts from the point a customer has produced real work in the platform through renewal. They are accountable for retention and adoption across that book.
* Our customers are HR directors, finance directors, and the analysts who support them. They use TrueComp to price union proposals, build salary schedules, and defend numbers in front of elected officials. Success in this role depends on being credible in those conversations, not just responsive to them.
* Roughly 15-20 accounts are named accounts managed on a set cadence. The remainder are covered through scheduled check-ins and usage-based triggers. Every account renews annually and the Customer Success Manager owns that conversation start to finish.
* This role reports to the Chief Operations Officer and works closely with sales, support, and product.

**What you'll do**

**Retention and Renewal**

* Own the renewal conversation for every account in your book, from early positioning through signed agreement.
* Run a renewal calendar that starts 120 days out, not 30. In public sector, the paperwork takes longer than the decision.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within your approved authority, and bring anything outside that band to the COO with a recommendation.
* Manage the mechanics — purchase orders, fiscal year timing, contract amendments, and re-bid requirements where they apply.
* Forecast renewals accurately and identify risk early enough to change the outcome.
* Maintain an account health view you can defend in a forecast review.

**Customer Relationships**

* Build working relationships with HR and finance leadership at each agency, not just your day-to-day contact.
* Understand each customer's operating calendar — budget adoption, bargaining cycles, council meetings — and plan engagement around it.
* Run a consistent cadence with named accounts covering usage, upcoming budget and negotiation cycles, and open issues.
* Own escalations end to end, pulling in support, product, or executive help when the situation calls for it.
* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities across additional modules, added agencies, and consulting engagements, and hand them to sales with the context needed to run them.

**Collaboration and Product Input**

* Route customer feedback and feature requests into the roadmap process with enough context and evidence for product and engineering to act.
* Work alongside the Onboarding Specialist from kickoff forward so the transition to your ownership is a handoff, not a reintroduction.
* Share patterns you see across your book with the broader team — recurring friction, competitive pressure, emerging use cases.

**Process and Tools**

* Track account activity, renewal forecasts, and escalations in Salesforce and keep records current.
* Contribute to building the customer success playbook. We are a 30-person company and you will help define process, not just follow it.

**Qualifications**

* Direct experience inside or alongside public sector HR or finance. That may be working at an agency, or working with agency HR and finance teams in a vendor, consulting, or advisory capacity.
* Working knowledge of compensation benchmarking, labor costing, or actuarial analysis. You do not need to be an actuary. You do need to hold your own in a conversation with a compensation analyst.
* Direct ownership of renewal outcomes in a prior role, including pricing conversations and negotiation.
* Working knowledge of public sector procurement — purchase orders, fiscal year cycles, contract amendments, and when a renewal becomes a competitive re-bid.
* 3-5 years managing customer relationships with direct retention and renewal accountability. SaaS experience preferred, not required.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a book of this size independently, prioritizing across accounts without close supervision.
* Written communication clear and concise enough that an HR director will actually read it.
* Preferred: Salesforce experience, prior work at a company under 100 employees, data literacy strong enough to read a usage report and know what it means.

**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

The Key Account Manager-CMD is responsible for the launching, maintenance, retention, and growth in iRhythm’s innovative commercial markets. This position is responsible for launching, cultivating, and sustaining long-term customer relationships, as well as ensuring KPIs are being met. Proactively deliver value services to support customers, and advocate internally for the solutions required to drive business outcomes, working across internal teams such as Marketing, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations. Act as the primary point of contact for customers when escalations and support intervention are required.

  

Specific job responsibilities include:

* Manage the complex, large- scale onboarding of 100+ accounts simultaneously, overseeing project timelines and collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop expertise in complex and innovative business models, collaborating with directors to devise and execute strategic plans that drive long-term value creation.
* Lead and contribute to high-level meetings with executives and C-suite leaders, facilitating strategic discussions and decision-making.
* Serve as the primary representative for assigned accounts, ensuring seamless communication and satisfaction.
* Strategic partner to iRhythm Commercial Market Development team to ensure initial and ongoing success of customers and patients within our large account segment.
* Provide proactive continuous evaluation of processes and procedures. Responsible for suggesting new methods to streamline operations through improved processes and additional technology
* Serve as primary lead for training material/schedule/rollout of the Zio Service during multi-site wide launch
* Manage internal and external stakeholder and project communication (includes updates to leadership, stakeholder alignment on project scope and milestones, and escalation of issues and risks)
* Engage with cross functional partners and internal teams as Project Manager during launch phase to ensure timelines and volume targets are met.
* Organizes project activities and interdepartmental meetings; ensures communication facilitates completion of the program/project on schedule and successfully
* Understand and communicate how goals fit into broader organizational goals, and prioritize tasks/schedule accordingly
* Sole point of contact for the Zio Service- from day to day issue resolution/communication with Practice Managers to driving growth and new initiatives with C- Suite
* Lead and facilitate customer meetings and quarterly business reviews with Directors, VPs, and C-Suite, (internal and external)
* Lead change within internal systems to follow the Think Bigger, Go Faster approach
* Customer/Account performance – Acting as a strategic business partner identifying opportunities for improvement in the health and wellness of assigned accounts.
* Serve as primary point of contact for iRhythm internal teams regarding assigned customers. Liaison with key stakeholders in billing, clinical operations, legal, finance, inventory and customer care to ensure efficient account performance.
* Provide customer training on iRhythm toolset (ZioSuite, MyZio, etc.)
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues
* Ability to understand customer workflow, make recommendations to improve performance, and leverage iRhythm expertise as necessary.
* Attend and support key customer meetings and quarterly business reviews (CMD team and customer meetings).
* Soley assigned to large, complex, highly visible and strategic accounts.
* Travel to and conduct account management initiatives as needed.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with accounts and internal sales organization.
* Monitor and communicate key performance trends across assigned accounts. Work to develop action plans to improve account performance.
* Active member / leader of special and ongoing projects that are important to customer and iRhythm’s success.

**About you:**

* 3 - 7 years of proven experience, with at least 3 years in account management/customer success.
* Population health or value-based care experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven work experience as an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Manager.
* Exceptionally collaborative, highly responsive, flexible and adaptive when working with customers and various teams within iRhythm.
* Must be self-directed and proactive.
* Consistently demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organization, including executive and C-level.
* Ability to make key decisions with little supervision- always keeping in mind what is best for our organization, our customers, and our patients
* Proven understanding of how to apply key measurements to drive commercial development
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with tools commonly used in a business environment including customer relationship management (Salesforce), reporting and Microsoft Office.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends and present information in a succinct and actionable manner.
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Must be willing to travel up to 20%.
