About Dyad: Dyad offers innovative, integrated software solutions designed for all facets of property and casualty insurance underwriting and distribution. Formed by the merger of XDimensional Technologies and I-Engineering, Dyad brings together the best of two industry leaders in the insurance technology space. Our insurance agency management software, carrier connectivity, policy admin and outsourcing solutions are built not just for where insurance organizations are today but also for their future trajectory. Dyad enables companies to improve their relationships, streamline processes, and capture business insights to drive sustainable, long-term growth.

Position Overview : Dyad is seeking a quota-carrying Account Manager to grow and retain a portfolio of 30–40 existing mid-market MGA customers. The portfolio includes customers using ALIS as their primary policy administration system and customers using Dyad point solutions that provide a foothold for a broader ALIS sale. You will own account expansion and renewals, with responsibility for increasing recurring revenue and protecting the existing revenue base.

As each customer’s primary U.S.-based point of contact, you will connect business needs with Dyad’s products and coordinate closely with senior leadership and our India-based support and implementation teams. Success requires a proactive approach to relationship management, a record of closing expansion business, and consistent follow-through on customer priorities. Compensation will be tied to quota attainment and revenue retention initiatives.

Key ResponsibilitiesAccount Growth and Commercial Ownership

* Own and grow 30–40 assigned mid-market accounts. Maintain account plans that document current products, stakeholders, contract terms, renewal dates, growth opportunities, and retention risks.
* Upsell ALIS customers by expanding programs, users, and other contracted capacity as their businesses grow and their needs evolve.
* Cross-sell additional Dyad products and capabilities. Build demand for planned roadmap offerings in coordination with Product, using approved availability and delivery expectations.
* Develop ALIS opportunities within customers using Dyad point solutions, leading discovery, business cases, demonstrations with Solution Consulting, proposals, and the sales process through close.
* Lead renewals and recontracting. Where appropriate, move customers to new pricing models and higher recurring revenue based on demonstrated value, expanded scope, and approved commercial terms.
* Qualify and manage expansion opportunities from discovery through negotiation and signature, partnering with Finance and Legal on pricing and contracts.

Customer Relationships and Revenue Retention

* Serve as the customer’s primary U.S.-based point of contact, building relationships with executive sponsors and operational, underwriting, and technology stakeholders.
* Conduct regular account reviews to understand business priorities, demonstrate value, assess adoption, and agree on actions that support growth and retention.
* Identify churn and contraction risks early, including unresolved service issues, low adoption, leadership changes, and competitive activity. Develop and execute retention plans with clear owners and follow-up.
* Coordinate customer escalations with India-based support and implementation teams. Maintain clear customer communication and track actions through resolution, with technical delivery owned by the responsible teams.

Internal Coordination and Sales Execution

* Work closely with Dyad’s senior leadership on executive engagement, account strategy, commercial decisions, and material customer risks.
* Coordinate with India-based teams across time zones on implementation progress, expansion readiness, and customer commitments. Partner with Product and Solution Consulting to align customer needs with available capabilities.
* Keep Salesforce current with account plans, contacts, activities, opportunities, renewal dates, retention risks, and next steps. Provide accurate expansion and renewal forecasts to the Chief Sales Officer and leadership.
* Use AI-assisted tools to prepare account briefs, analyze customer conversations, and prioritize opportunities. Share recurring customer needs and product feedback with internal teams.

Measures of Success

* Attainment of assigned revenue growth quota through cross-sell, upsell, ALIS sales within point-solution accounts, and pricing or contract expansion.
* Gross and net revenue retention across the assigned portfolio, including timely renewals, execution of retention initiatives, and reduction of churn and contraction.
* Qualified expansion pipeline, forecast accuracy, and consistent execution of account plans and customer follow-up.

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of quota-carrying account management or expansion sales experience in SaaS or insurance technology, with a record of growing and retaining an existing customer portfolio.
* Demonstrated success closing cross-sell and upsell opportunities, managing renewals, and negotiating pricing changes or contract expansions while maintaining strong customer relationships.
* Experience serving P&C insurance organizations and understanding MGA operations, policy administration workflows, and how software supports underwriting and distribution.
* Ability to prioritize a portfolio of 30–40 accounts while managing concurrent sales opportunities, renewals, and customer issues.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, including opportunity management, account planning, reporting, and forecasting; comfort using AI-assisted productivity tools.

Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. jobs.title: IT Support Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Agilify builds custom applications, cloud platforms and AI solutions for clients, then supports them in production. We are hiring a Support Manager to own that support: the person accountable for every ticket that reaches us, for the engineers who resolve it, and for what we tell the client.

The applications you will support include web and workflow applications, their integrations to enterprise platforms, data and reporting platforms, and AI services that produce recommendations for human review. You may hold more than one client engagement at a time. This is a coordination role with a technical center of gravity: you will not write the fix, but you need to understand it well enough to judge whether the estimate is reasonable and whether what you are telling the client is accurate.

**Responsibilities**

*Service Delivery and Scope*

* Single point of accountability for every ticket: acknowledge within the agreed response time, confirm ownership, assign severity, and drive to resolution against the agreed service levels.

* Operate a tiered support model, where the client typically handles first-line intake and Agilify picks up at second line, escalating to engineering when needed.

* Determine whether a root cause sits in the application, a platform service or a client-owned system, and manage third-party cases to closure.

* Track contracted hours or allowances against consumption, notify the client before limits are reached, and hold work until it is authorized.

* Classify requests between defect resolution, routine maintenance, minor change and work requiring a change request. This governs what is billable and is the most common source of dispute.

*Coordination and Client Relationship*

* Assign and sequence work across application, data, cloud, machine learning and test engineering, with architects available on escalation.

* Run the working cadence: stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint planning and retrospectives for enhancement work, and triage for reactive work.

* Manage dependencies with client resolver groups, and escalate early rather than after a target has been missed.

* Produce weekly and monthly service reporting, lead the periodic business review, and surface work falling outside the agreement as a scoping conversation rather than absorbing it quietly.

* Hold the day-to-day client relationship, translate between business and engineering in both directions, and make sure the client hears about a problem from us first.

**Required skills**

* Five or more years coordinating technical delivery or production support teams, with direct accountability for service levels against a formal agreement.

* A technical background in software delivery. You should have shipped software, not only managed people who did.

* Agile delivery experience including backlog management, sprint planning and estimation, with judgment about where Agile ceremonies help a support function and where they get in the way.

* Working understanding of modern application architecture, enough cloud literacy to tell an application defect from a platform fault, enough data literacy to reason about pipelines, and comfort with version control, CI/CD and environment promotion.

* Hands-on use of a ticketing and change management platform, and experience explaining a missed commitment and the recovery plan with the client in the room.

* Precise written communication, composure under escalation, and willingness to report a problem before being asked.

**Preferred experience**

Managed the development or implementation of the following solution platforms.

* **.NET development —** C# and the .NET stack. Part of our supported estate is built this way.

* **AI and machine learning —** agentic systems, decision records and audit, guardrails, and tracing a recommendation back through its evidence. Enough modeling literacy to follow a discussion about versioning and drift.

* **Cloud and data platforms —** AWS or Azure, infrastructure as code, and a modern business intelligence platform.

* **Regulated environments and certification —** experience where formal quality assurance and change control apply. Certified Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, PMP, ITIL or a cloud associate certification.

Pay: From $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* managing technical teams with SLA accountability: 5 years (Required)
* developing and shipping software to production: 2 years (Required)
* managing Agile backlogs, sprints, and estimates: 3 years (Required)
* cloud platforms, application architecture, and CI/CD: 3 years (Required)
* using ticketing and change management systems: 2 years (Required)
* managing client escalations and service recovery plans: 3 years (Required)

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst to be the analytical engine behind our GTM organization. You'll own pipeline reporting and forecasting, run and improve our Salesforce environment and GTM tech stack, and support annual territory, quota, and capacity planning. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, and CX to turn data into decisions that drive predictable revenue growth.

A key focus of the role will be modernizing GTM operations through automation and AI. You'll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, accelerate reporting and analysis, improve data quality, and leverage tools such as Claude to uncover insights and support better decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on GTM operations expertise across marketing and sales with strategic thinking, technical fluency, strong analytical skills, and a builder mindset.

### **About the role**

* Define and own the core GTM metrics framework, measuring performance from first lead engagement through pipeline, bookings, and revenue: pipeline generation, conversion rates by stage, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle, ACV/ARR growth, and net retention.

* Run full-funnel analysis from lead to closed-won to renewal, including win/loss, deal velocity, discounting, and pricing trends, to identify where deals stall and why and to inform sales strategy and deal desk policy.

* Build rep and team productivity analyses: ramp time, activity-to-outcome ratios, attainment distribution, and capacity utilization.

* Perform cohort and segment analysis (by industry, region, deal size, product, and channel) to guide where to invest.

* Build reporting and dashboards that join CRM, marketing, product usage, and finance data into a single view of the business, covering campaign performance, attribution, pipeline coverage and contribution, forecast accuracy, and GTM efficiency.

* Go beyond reporting what happened: use AI and analytical tools, including Claude, to run ad-hoc deep dives for the leadership team, surface trends, analyze why performance changed, and turn findings into concise recommendations with clear owners and next steps.

* Partner with Demand Generation, Digital, Field, Partner, and Product Marketing to evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve conversion and ROI.

* Build capacity, quota, and scenario models with Finance and Sales leadership, including "what-if" analyses for headcount, pipeline coverage, and target-setting; maintain quota attainment tracking.

* Support sales compensation plan design, modeling, and monthly commission calculation and validation.

**Data Governance**

* Establish and enforce standards for database hygiene, normalization, deduplication, account hierarchies, segmentation, enrichment, campaign taxonomy, and data quality.

* Own and optimize FireMon’s GTM technology ecosystem, ensuring tools are integrated, adopted, scalable, and delivering value, and recommend where platforms should be added, consolidated, replaced, or eliminated.

* Maintain documentation of system architecture, integrations, workflows, and business rules.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS or technology company.

* Hands-on Salesforce experience: building reports and dashboards, configuring fields, flows, and validation rules.

* Proven ownership of the sales forecast process, pipeline reporting, and territory, quota, and capacity planning cycles for a multi-segment sales team.

* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker); advanced Excel / Google Sheets modeling (lookups, pivots, scenario models).

* Strong project management skills and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate ambiguous business questions into clear analysis and recommendations for executives, and to train and influence sales teams.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience with statistical analysis, or with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

* Experience with forecasting and revenue intelligence tools (e.g., Clari, Gong) and incentive comp platforms (e.g., CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly).

* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity GTM teams, including channel or partner-sourced deals and ABM or intent-driven marketing.

* Familiarity with CPQ and quote-to-cash processes.

* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, integration platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.

new_jobs.title: Research Program Coordinator – Reproductive Health
new_jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 6 months

The Research Program Coordinator will serve as a key analyst and coordinator supporting the programmatic and research activities of the Principal Investigator within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences.

The position supports multiple grant-funded research projects focused on patient-provider communication, particularly in the areas of pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare. The Coordinator will conduct moderately complex qualitative and quantitative analytical work, support manuscript preparation and submission, and coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities. The research does not involve clinical trials.

The Coordinator will collaborate with UCSF departments, the San Francisco Department of Public Health, research and administrative partners, and outside consultants. The role will also evaluate research processes, data collection and storage practices, and available technologies and services to identify alternatives and make sound recommendations.

The position is within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, a major academic department in the School of Medicine committed to healthcare, education, and research. The role is based within the department’s Zuckerberg San Francisco General division, whose mission includes promoting justice, quality, and equity in women’s healthcare.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct qualitative and quantitative data collection, cleaning, analysis, and other analytical activities supporting multiple research studies focused on patient-provider communication, pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare.
* Develop and support systems for research data collection, research-subject communication, and confidential data management.
* Prepare, edit, and modify manuscripts, presentations, abstracts, study instruments, research posters, syllabus materials, letters of recommendation, and other research-related documents.
* Conduct professional literature reviews and gather, synthesize, and analyze information to prepare reports and analyses for the Principal Investigator.
* Prepare and present research summaries, reports, and other materials for meetings and internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities, including meetings, conference activities, research activities, grant applications, vendor selection and setup, and joint abstract submissions.
* Coordinate program and project activities with research and project staff and collaborate across UCSF departments and administrative units.
* Interface with partners including the Office of Sponsored Research, Research Administration, and San Francisco Department of Public Health departments as needed.
* Evaluate issues and research processes, gather relevant information, assess alternatives, and recommend approaches to data collection and storage based on available technologies and services.
* Support activities that advance UCSF PRIDE Values and Principles of Community and contribute to an inclusive environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any area.
* At least one year of related experience or equivalent training.
* Working knowledge of common organizational or research-specific computer applications, including Microsoft Office, particularly word processing and intermediate Excel functions.
* Proficient verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities within demanding timeframes.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment when responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, research, and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated interest in sexual and reproductive health, including comfort with family planning and abortion, and infectious diseases including HIV.
* Knowledge of qualitative research concepts and applications.
Ability to take initiative and direction and complete tasks in a timely and comprehensive manner.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, behavioral science, or another related area.
* Three years of experience working in an academic, research, public health, or related setting.
* Knowledge of survey software such as REDCap or Qualtrics.

  

**About UCSF**

  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

  
  

**Pride Values**

  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Job Description:

**Case Manager**

**Zygmunt Arendt Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program and Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s Zygmunt Arendt Supportive Services Program provides on-site case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include case management, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and research within its community-based services.

**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Lead Case Manager and/or supervisor, the Case Manager works in direct service with individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. The Case Manager holds a full caseload, works directly with the interdisciplinary team to reach out and engage all tenants, assess their needs upon move-in and throughout their residency, and connect tenants to those services, working to overcome obstacles with the residents and their care team. The Case Manager will connect tenants to services including benefits, entitlements, vocational or educational resources, mental health, medical, and substance use services, and any other appropriate resources, as needed. This person will also provide support to individuals in learning independent living skills, communication skills, social skills, and other necessary skills to support independence, maintain housing stability, and promote mental health recovery.

The Case Manager meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Case Manager maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations. This person will also bring expertise regarding the specific needs of older adults and those entering housing from homelessness, as well as connections to community resources, recreational opportunities, and other connections to necessary services.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Participate closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Participate in intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Recommend case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with clinicians or other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Develop systems and maintain ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices for the teams.
* Accountable for data input into the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Provide activities and groups with the tenants.
* Advise tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Recommend specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Participate in emergency wellness checks.

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.

* Ability to work cooperatively on a multidisciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.

new_jobs.description:
**CHURCH OF OUR SAVIOUR, MILL VALLEY - OPERATIONS MANAGER**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

**Overview:**

The Operations Manager has general responsibility for the management of all office functions,

bookkeeping and overseeing the maintenance and repair of the buildings and grounds of

the Episcopal Church of Our Saviour, Mill Valley. The person in this role will often be the first

impression members of the public and parishioners have of the parish and so in addition to

ensuring that the operations of the parish all are smoothly running, this person should enjoy

creating a warm and hospitable environment. All are Welcome at the Church of Our Saviour.

This position reports directly to the acting Rector of the parish and provides him/her direct

administrative support while also providing administrative support to the Vestry (lay board of

the parish), other clergy, and key parish ministry leaders.

**Key Responsibilities: (detailed accountabilities below)**

● Bookkeeping - this role will be responsible for timely and accurate bookkeeping for the

parish, including payables and receivables, donation and pledge management, regular

reporting for diocesan and parish needs, review of invoices, and handling deposits.

● Office functions - the successful Operations Manager ensures that the office is well

organized, well-equipped, tidy, welcoming and stocked and that systems and processes,

tools and technologies are in place to absorb requests from across the parish. The office

functions of the Operations Managers will include administrative tasks (such as

scheduling facilities use, responding to and appropriately directing phone and email

inquiries, managing the office accounts, subscriptions, machines and supplies), member

management (including maintaining and filing parish records, meeting minutes,

updating the parish directory, developing a robust communications program, ensuring all

announcements and events are published across communications channels and digital

platforms) and leader support (including staff and ministry leaders with scheduling

volunteers, procuring necessary supplies, and producing materials for church services,

such as bulletins, hand-outs, music inserts, etc.)

● Building and Grounds Management - in coordination with Junior Warden, the Office

Manager is responsible for scheduling regular and ad hoc work, for the maintenance and

repair of COS facilities (including church building, grounds and nearby rectory) and

ensures successful and timely completion of maintenance and repairs. This includes

management of janitorial services, gardening and landscaping services, handymen and

specialist service providers (musical instrument maintenance, stained glass repair,

plumbing, electrical, etc.)

**Required Qualifications and Competencies:**

● Equivalent to a minimum of three (3) years of administrative experience;

● Facility with computers and applications related to the work, including word processing,

spreadsheet applications, web design, database / CRM, and SaaS workspaces are a

must;

● Knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping practices;

● Strong english language skills, including, spelling, grammar, and punctuation relevant to

business communications;

● Ability to understand, interpret, apply, and explain the church’s policies and procedures;

● Use of tact, initiative, discretion, and judgment within church policy and legal guidelines

in sensitive situations;

● Ability to establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with

those contacted in the course of work;

● Ability to provide a high level of customer service when dealing with the public,

parishioners, church staff and volunteers;

● Demonstrated ability to organize own work, set priorities, meet critical deadlines and

follow-up on assignments;

● Propensity to take initiative and exercise independent judgement in decision making

within the scope of the role;

● Ability to effectively coordinate the work of certain vendors, contractors, and service

providers through delivery of clear instruction and timely responses

● Ability and desire to effectively leverage technology to improve efficiency of office

processes and systems

● Willingness and desire to observe any operating gaps and to “fill-in” when needed with

other duties as needed or as assigned.

● Experience in a church or other ministry setting is preferred. Knowledge of the

Episcopal Church is a huge plus.

**Detailed Accountabilities:**

**Bookkeeping:**

● Reviews invoices for payment, forwards to appropriate individuals for approval and

follows up until approval is received.

● Handles entry and resolution of all payables and receivables.

● Tracks donation and annual pledges.

● Provides regular reporting for the Diocese of California.

● Provides regular financial reports for the Finance Committee and Vestry review.

● Prepares for and participates in monthly finance committee meetings.

● Assists in preparation of annual parish reports to the congregation and diocese.

● Prepares weekly deposit slips for offerings and checks received.

● Distributes quarterly and annual mailings to pledging parishioners.

● Submitting hourly payroll schedule.

● Reconciling bank account.

● Paying diocesan assessment.

● Paying employee benefits.

● Paying pensions.

**Office Functions:**

● Responds to requests for information and resources via email, telephone, and in-person

visits.

● Sorts incoming mail; sends parish mailings and other outgoing mail.

● Maintains office equipment and office subscriptions: including copiers, computers, and

telephone system in working order; coordinates service as needed.

● Maintains office supplies and supplies needed for ministries.

● Maintains licenses, passwords, and media for computer related tools and services used

by or for the parish (e.g., computer applications, website, ISP, telephone, equipment).

● Maintains personnel files for all regular staff

**About Sifted**

Jess Legge and Kimberly Lexow were masters of the 9 to 5 - working at a high-growth tech start-up, with one question: “Could the work lunch be better?”

It’s an expectation these days that work is hard and fast. But lunch doesn’t have to be that way. Imagining an office where employees want to stick around and share a table of inspired food, Legge and Lexow founded Sifted in 2015.

Since then we’ve delivered millions of meals to Fortune 500s and high-growth startups across the US. When COVID-19 hit, our clients needed a partner to help them manage their new normal. That’s when we created our virtual team building experiences. Now as companies fully embrace the future of a flexible workplace, Sifted has become a comprehensive employee experience partner offering both in-office catering services + an extensive portfolio of engaging virtual experiences for distributed teams.

* Good food is powerful
* Simple food is the best food
* We support regular people with big ideas
* We make mistakes and evolve
* We appreciate people’s differences
* We seek, listen and implement feedback quickly + enthusiastically

Supports the division’s financial goals and P&L management with cost/benefit evaluations, Pricing studies, and ROI analyses to optimize margins and support revenue growth.

**Overview**
------------

Join Intuit as a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Success team. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure, driving execution, and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable programs.

In this role, you’ll define and lead cross-functional programs that support our global customer base. You’ll work in ambiguous spaces, partner closely with product, operations, and go-to-market teams, and own programs end to end, from outcomes and governance model through delivery and sustained adoption. You’ll connect business strategy to execution, make the tradeoffs clear, and keep teams focused on the work that matters most.

This role requires strong operational fundamentals, deep domain expertise, and the ability to run multiple workstreams at once. You’ll regularly present recommendations to senior leaders, lead experts through problem solving, and use AI and the best available tools alongside human judgment to move faster and raise the quality of the work. You’ll also help raise the bar for the craft by sharing what works with your peers.

**Responsibilities**

* **Connect Strategy to Execution:** Translate business strategy, customer context, and internal realities into clear priorities, decisions, and execution paths across a complex program or multiple programs. Lead tradeoff discussions, recommend a path forward, and make sure decisions are followed through.
* **Program Design & Launch:** Partner across teams to define program outcomes and success metrics aligned to Customer Success and GBSG goals, build the program framework and end-to-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model.
* **Operating Rhythm:** Develop and drive the operating rhythm for your programs to set direction, monitor performance, and create clear accountability. Lead workstream owners to meet program success measures.
* **Risk, Dependencies & Clear Communication:** Partner across teams to uncover risks and dependencies early, escalate blockers, and quickly determine the path to green. Use data and insights to communicate progress and trends, recommend decisions, and propose changes to the plan.
* **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly get up to speed on new program areas and build an end-to-end blueprint. Use deep domain knowledge to ask the right questions, bring in the right experts, address process and priority gaps, and lead those experts through problem solving to shape decisions.
* **Lead Change:** Build credibility and trust across teams as a boundaryless change leader. Identify the impacts of key changes, develop the change plan, and drive it from plan to sustained adoption with a compelling, data-backed case for change.
* **AI & Tools:** Use AI and analytical tools as thought partners to speed up analysis, sharpen recommendations, and surface risks, while holding AI-assisted outputs to the same quality bar as any other work.
* **Enable Scale & Velocity:** Contribute new frameworks, practices, and templates, enhance existing ones, and adopt approaches proven by peers. Experiment with new approaches, including AI, tie them to outcomes, and share learnings so they scale across programs. Coach others on program management fundamentals.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience in ambiguous problem spaces, bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to new initiatives.
* Strong program management fundamentals, including end-to-end planning, governance, risk and dependency management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Data-driven mindset, with the ability to use metrics and insights to recommend decisions and communicate progress and risks.
* Proven ability to present recommendations to senior leaders and drive decisions across teams.
* Ability to operate at both the strategic level (goals, priorities, tradeoffs) and the tactical level (day-to-day execution).
* Track record of leading change, from building the case through sustained adoption, and influencing without authority.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, communication, and program delivery, with sound judgment on quality.
* Clear, effective communicator in both written and verbal formats.
* Passion for customer success and delivering real, measurable impact.

Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.

* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.
* Take on other defined projects as agreed with the President, with priorities adjusted to match available capacity.

How responsibilities fit together

Procurement owns purchasing records and supplier purchasing activity. Receiving owns receiving records and material discrepancies. Production owns its schedule and execution.

You own the integrated job dashboard, cross-team follow-through, and coordination through customer delivery. You’ll work with these team members to identify risks, evaluate their recommendations, and drive next steps.

You’ll have the President’s backing to request timely updates, establish action deadlines with the team, and escalate unresolved commitments. Functional leads remain accountable for execution within their areas.

The President resolves competing customer priorities, significant escalations, and decisions beyond your authority. Customer delivery takes priority over additional internal projects.

What we’re looking for

* Evidence of taking responsibility and seeing work through completion.
* Strong organization across multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Resourcefulness when information is missing or instructions are incomplete.
* Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and apply what you learn.
* Confidence following up with experienced teammates, suppliers, and customers.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Attention to detail with dates, quantities, part numbers, documents, and records.
* Judgment about when to act, when to seek input, and when to escalate.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared trackers, email, and business software.
* A collaborative approach and dependable follow-through without repeated reminders.

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Quality Assurance Inspector inspects precision-machined components against print and quality standards at first piece, in-process and final stages. You keep every lot accurate and documented under our ISO 9001 quality system, so parts ship right the first time. This position is for the Swing Shift beginning at 2:30pm.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Perform first piece acceptance inspections on the shop floor for CNC operations.
* Conduct receiving, in-process and final mechanical and visual inspections.
* Run CMM inspections and verify tight tolerances.
* Conduct First Article Inspections (FAIs) and prepare reports as required by the QMS and customers.
* Complete final inspection and certification packages on finished parts before shipment.
* Create and maintain quality records, and enter inspection data into company systems.
* Help keep measuring devices calibrated and maintained per company procedure and ISO 9001
* Help disposition discrepant material through the discrepant material reporting system.
* Support customer, internal and third-party audits.
* Support continuous improvement and the company's quality objectives.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 6+ years of inspection experience in a machining job shop.
* Skilled with calipers, micrometers, height gages, indicators, thread and plug gages, and CMM inspection.
* Blueprint reading and working knowledge of GD&T.
* Able to interpret customer paperwork to complete shipping and final inspection documents.
* Able to multitask, prioritize and manage time in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable using computers for data entry and record keeping.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* CMM programming experience, preferrably with PC-DMIS
* Experience with optical comparators and air gaging.
* Working knowledge of trigonometry.
* Working knowledge of gage calibration systems.
* Experience in an ISO 9001 environment.

**Benefits**
------------

* Benefits vary by location and typically include:
* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid vacation, paid holidays and paid sick days
* Paid training and cross-training, with a clear path to advance
* A clean, safe, well-equipped shop

---------------

Many Talon companies perform defense work subject to U.S. export-control rules (ITAR). For those positions, candidates must be a U.S. Person (a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).

**How to apply**
----------------

Apply through the job posting or contact the hiring location directly. Our process is simple: apply, interview, tour the shop, and receive an offer.

**About Talon Precision**

Talon Precision is building the premier precision machining and advanced manufacturing company serving aerospace, defense, medical, semiconductor, space and other mission-critical markets. **Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations so AI answers can be traced, challenged and proved. Our architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team from Google, DeepMind and Glean, bringing together frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. Our commercial team is building the go-to-market motion to bring this technology to enterprises where correctness matters most.

**The Role**
------------

At a fast-moving research company, small execution gaps can slow down important work. We are looking for an Operations Associate who makes the company run better: someone who anticipates needs, creates order in ambiguity, communicates thoughtfully and closes loops without needing to be chased. You will partner closely with the Chief of Staff and work across recruiting, commercial operations and broader company priorities. One day may involve coordinating a high-stakes customer meeting; another, improving an interview process, supporting a team event or owning an operational project from start to finish. This is a high-trust, hands-on role with room to grow into increasingly independent ownership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Keep critical external engagements moving: coordinate customer and partner meetings, prepare participants, track follow-ups and ensure every commitment has an owner and next step.
* Own an excellent candidate experience through interview scheduling, interviewer coordination, confirmations, reschedules, clear communications and accurate ATS updates.
* Support daily company operations such as team events, visitors, vendors, office logistics, documentation and lightweight purchasing coordination as needs arise.
* Build simple, reliable trackers for priorities, deadlines, decisions and cross-functional dependencies; surface conflicts early instead of allowing silent slippage.
* Prepare crisp agendas, briefs, meeting notes and status updates so leaders enter conversations prepared and leave with actionable decisions.
* Spot recurring friction, improve checklists and templates, and implement lightweight automation rather than repeating avoidable manual work.
* Handle confidential people and commercial information with judgment, warmth and discretion; take ownership of increasingly complex projects as you earn trust.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* Outstanding organization, attention to detail and follow-through, including the ability to manage simultaneous time-sensitive work without dropping commitments.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder judgment with executives, candidates, customers and vendors.
* Comfort coordinating calendars across time zones, working in Google Workspace and spreadsheets, and learning systems such as Ashby and HubSpot.
* A service mindset without passivity: you anticipate problems, ask the right questions, propose fixes and communicate risks early.
* Resilience and calm under shifting priorities, plus the ability to decide when to act independently and when to escalate.
* Curiosity about how a company is built and enthusiasm for improving systems, not only completing individual tasks.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience in recruiting coordination, executive operations, sales coordination, workplace operations or a fast-growing startup.
* Built a scheduling or operating workflow that reduced errors, improved response times or made stakeholders meaningfully more effective.
* Familiarity with Ashby, HubSpot, workflow automation, vendor coordination or internal-event execution.

RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional **Legal Operations Manager.**

**About RainFocus:**

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly-growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Cisco, Oracle, Gartner, and VMware to prepare and execute events, each with tens of thousands of attendees, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing teams. We are well-funded, growing fast, taking on an established industry leader, and building a company that is changing the market—it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

**About the Role:**

The Legal Operations Manager serves as the central operational hub bridging Legal, Procurement, Privacy, and Information Security. Reporting directly to the VP of Legal & Corporate Services, this role blends substantive paralegal capability with end-to-end vendor procurement lifecycle management and contract portfolio administration.

In this role, you will take ownership of the company's agreement ecosystem, with a heavy operational focus on vendor procurement, SaaS contracts, and third-party supplier agreements, alongside client MSAs, Partner Agreements, and NDAs. You will work closely on a day-to-day basis with our Business Systems and Information Security teams to route, audit, and secure all required documentation—including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), security exhibits, system integrations, and compliance paperwork. Further, you will serve as a trusted second set of eyes: autonomously redlining standard agreements against playbooks, tracking renewal pipelines, flagging risk and liability outliers, managing insurance documentation, and acting as an operational extension of the team to ensure seamless continuity across all corporate legal workflows.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Procurement & Vendor Contract Management**

* Vendor Lifecycle Administration: Own the operational workflow for new and existing vendor engagements, with heavy emphasis on SaaS, professional services, software licenses, and IT infrastructure agreements.
* Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Systems to align software license terms, seat counts, and integration requirements, and collaborate with Information Security to ensure required security exhibits, SOC reports, and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) are fully vetted and executed.
* Renewal & Expiration Management: Build and maintain an active renewal calendar for all vendor and SaaS agreements. Issue proactive alerts to internal business owners well in advance of auto-renewal, price escalation, and notice-of-non-renewal deadlines.
* Vendor Offboarding Governance: Lead formal contract offboarding when vendors are decommissioned, ensuring notices of termination are delivered, auto-renewals are halted, and data destruction/transition provisions are verified alongside Security and IT.

**Legal Support, Redlining & Departmental Backfill**

* Autonomous NDA Negotiation: Review, redline, and finalize inbound and outbound Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) using established company playbooks and approved fallback positions.
* VP & Operational Coverage: Serve as the primary triage point for operational legal inquiries; keep routine contracting matters, standard amendments, and internal approvals moving forward seamlessly.
* DocuSign Administration & Signature Routing: Serve as the primary DocuSign administrator across the company; configure signature workflows, build and maintain reusable templates, enforce proper routing hierarchies, and ensure complete execution and audit trails for all corporate documents.
* Playbook & Intake Optimization: Maintain and refine standard legal intake procedures, review checklists, and standard clause libraries to streamline internal handoffs between Legal, Procurement, and Security.
* Event & Vendor COI Management: Request, review, submit, and maintain event Certificates of Insurance (COIs) required by venues for corporate onsite events; collect and verify COIs and endorsement forms from third-party contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with policy limits.

**Contract Auditing, Repository Ownership & Querying**

* Central Repository Ownership: Ingest, organize, tag, and audit 100% of executed agreements across the company (vendor, client, partner, contractor, and corporate leases) in the central contract management system.
* Substantive Risk Querying: Query and analyze historical and incoming contracts to generate actionable reports on key legal and business terms, such as limitation of liability caps, indemnities, service level agreements (SLAs), governing law, and outlier provisions.
* Internal Stakeholder Reporting: Produce recurring status dashboards for executive leadership detailing active contract pipelines, upcoming renewal exposures, and vendor spend commitments.

### **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Experience: 2–5+ years of experience in an in-house corporate legal department, working as a corporate paralegal, contracts manager, or legal operations specialist with substantial procurement involvement.

* Legal & Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to read, analyze, and spot issues in commercial terms across SaaS agreements, MSAs, and NDAs (e.g., limitation of liability, indemnification, termination rights, data ownership, IP).

* Cross-Functional Proficiency: Demonstrated success collaborating directly with Information Security (handling DPAs, security riders) and Business Systems/IT teams (handling SaaS licensing and software terms).

*VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. *Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.*

**About the role**
------------------

This role sits next to our Product Manager and inside the Engineering team. You'll own the operational side of how we plan, ship, and report on work: the cycle cadence, ticket hygiene, release coordination, and cross-functional program management across product, engineering, ML, and CS.

This is a hands-on, proactive operating role. You're the person a fast-moving engineering team routes through. You keep the work moving without waiting to be asked, and you make the way the team works a little better every cycle.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Cycle operations**

* Run the team's three-week cycle cadence, including kickoff, daily standups, scope check-ins, demos, and retrospectives
* Keep blockers moving by getting each one to the person who can clear it, the same day
* Own the delivery record, the single tracker that shows the team, leadership, and CS where every piece of work stands
* Log lost time against each commitment the day it happens, and flag early when scope needs a cut

### **Ticket hygiene**

* Maintain high-quality tickets with clear acceptance criteria and correct prioritization
* Ensure work is properly structured (parents, dependencies, scope)
* Identify and clean up orphaned, duplicate, or stale tickets
* Push back on stories that are not ready for development

### **Cross-functional program management**

* Coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams, including Product, Engineering, ML, and Customer Success
* Manage dependencies across areas such as integrations, data pipelines, and customer readiness
* Act as the connective tissue to keep projects moving forward
* Route incoming requests to the right place (on-call, a small-fixes queue, or a future cycle) so work doesn't get assigned through DMs

### **Release coordination**

* Track what is included in each release
* Draft release notes and communicate updates clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with Customer Success to prepare for customer-facing changes
* Keep teams informed without creating unnecessary noise

### **Process improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows
* Propose and implement practical improvements
* Continuously evolve team processes rather than simply maintaining them
* Run the team's written playbook from day one, and take ownership of it once you've run a full cycle

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

#### **Experience**

4+ years as a project manager, technical program manager, or scrum master in a software organization.

#### **Working style**

* Comfortable in an engineering room. You can follow a technical debate without needing translation.
* Not afraid to push back when a senior dev says “just trust me.”
* You care about the craft of project management more than the title.
* You have opinions about how teams should work, but aren't dogmatic. Methodology is a tool, not a rulebook.
* You'd rather build a useful spreadsheet than implement a heavy framework.
* Comfortable being the only PM in a room of engineers.
* You're the hub. The team routes through you, so you're reachable and responsive during core hours, and you protect focus time without becoming hard to find.
* You finish what you pick up, completely and correctly, without needing someone to check on it.

#### **Mindset**

* Strong written communication. A lot of our work happens asynchronously and in writing.
* Comfort with ambiguity. We have a written process, and it changes every time we learn something. You'll run it and make it better.
* You care about where the work lands. The dollars our product helps move go to university scholarships, hospital research, and food banks, and that should matter to you.
* Curious about AI as a product surface, not just a hype cycle.
* Excited by building infrastructure from scratch instead of inheriting something polished.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, or B2B Sa

Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.

Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.

* Provide feedback to product & engineering teams to help refine our software platform

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a related field preferred
* Direct experience preparing, submitting, and obtaining building permits
* Strong understanding of architectural drawings, construction documents, and the building permitting process
* Ability to independently research permit requirements with a high degree of accuracy

$80,000 - $95,000 base + Equity

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Project Manager**  
  
**Company Overview:**  
Faith Group, LLC is a women-owned business headquartered in St. Louis, MO, with eight regional offices nationwide. We are a recognized leader in systems engineering, consulting, and professional services for clients whose facilities are their business. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Integrity, Dignity, Quality, Impact, Collaboration, and Innovation. We have supported thousands of projects across Aviation, Transit & Rail, Federal, State & Local Government, Data Centers, Education, and Commercial markets. From planning through design, engineering, construction, and commissioning, Faith Group supports clients throughout the life of the project, from start to finish!  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Project Manager will lead the delivery of low voltage technology system design and construction projects for clients across Faith Group’s markets, with a focus on aviation and federal work. Projects range from new facilities and terminals to renovations, large and small, and standalone system upgrades. Low voltage systems include IT, Communications, Physical Security, Audio-Visual, and specialized technology systems. The Project Manager is accountable for scope, schedule, budget, and quality across the full project lifecycle, from planning and design through construction administration, testing, training, and closeout, and serves as the primary point of contact for clients, partners, and the project team.  
  
**Location:**

**This is a remote position, however candidates must be located on the East Coast to be considered.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing expectations, requirements, and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
* Plan, execute, and close out projects, developing project scope, work plans, schedules, and budgets, and managing risks and scope changes.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of engineers, designers, and subject matter experts, and manage sub-consultant scope, performance, and invoicing.
* Monitor project financials, including budgets, forecasts, invoicing, and change orders, and report project status to leadership.
* Plan and lead client, partner, and internal meetings to ensure clear and concise communication, including agendas, minutes, and action item tracking.
* Coordinate project requirements and deliverables with owners, architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Oversee the development of construction drawings, specifications, and cost estimates, and coordinate with the Operations group to ensure QA/QC is completed for all deliverables.
* Support the construction administration process, including submittal and RFI reviews, site observations, testing, training, and project closeout.
* Ensure project work complies with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements, including aviation and federal agency criteria where applicable.
* Support business development efforts, including proposals, fee estimates, and client relationship building.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Associate’s degree in Applied Science or a related technical field required; Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field preferred.
* 2 to 5+ years of experience in design, consulting, or project management for low voltage and/or electrical systems.
* Experience managing design and construction projects as a project manager, lead designer, or similar role, including responsibility for scope, schedule, and budget.
* Experience on aviation design and construction projects, such as terminals, concourses, and airport technology systems, with familiarity with FAA, TSA, and CBP requirements, is preferred.
* Experience on federal design and construction projects, such as DoD, GSA, or VA facilities, with familiarity with federal design criteria (e.g., UFC) and federal contracting requirements, is preferred.
* Active federal security clearance, or the ability to obtain one, is preferred.
* PMP, RCDD, PSP, CTS-D, or similar industry certifications are preferred. A PE license is a plus.
* Working experience with BIM, Revit, and Microsoft Office products; familiarity with project scheduling tools.
* Proven communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to self-manage throughout the project and work as part of a team.
* Active participation in industry organizations such as AAAE, ACI-NA, SAME, or BICSI is a plus.

**Salary:**

* $140,000 - $170,000 final compensation will be determined based on education & certifications, experience, skill set, location, etc.

**Benefits:**

* 100% employer paid healthcare for employee
* 50% employer paid spouse/domestic partner/dependent healthcare
* Dental
* Vision
* 401k & Employer Match
* Short Term Disability
* 100% employer paid Long Term Disability
* 100% employer paid Life/ADD Insurance
* Additional Life/ADD Insurance Available
* FSA

Faith Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued and respected.

new_jobs.description:
Service Delivery Manager

Location: USA, Remote

**Position Overview**

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for managing the successful delivery, deployment, and activation of Nile's networking solutions across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.

This role serves as the primary technical project manager, coordinating internal engineering teams, deployment resources, third-party partners, logistics, and customer stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with Nile's delivery standards.

The SDM owns the customer deployment experience from project initiation through implementation, activation, stabilization, and formal handoff to the Customer Success organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management capabilities with technical networking knowledge, customer-facing leadership, and the ability to drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Service Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery execution for assigned customer deployments, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and according to established quality standards.
* Lead customer onboarding and deployment activities from project kickoff through implementation, activation, and operational handoff.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and communication across all delivery workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and potential blockers, implementing mitigation plans before they impact customer outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deployments across different geographies and levels of complexity.

**2. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the deployment and implementation lifecycle.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, technical workshops, and executive-level project updates.
* Set clear customer expectations around timelines, responsibilities, prerequisites, and deployment scope.
* Build strong relationships with customer IT leadership, project managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Proactively manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution in collaboration with internal teams.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and consistent customer experience throughout the deployment journey.

**3. Cross-Functional Team Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Service Engineering, Network Engineering, Product, Support, and Customer Success.
* Ensure appropriate technical discovery, design validation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) signoff before deployment execution.
* Work with Service Delivery Engineers (SDEs), deployment engineers, and external partners to coordinate implementation activities.
* Ensure alignment between pre-sales commitments and delivery execution.
* Drive effective collaboration between Day 0/Day 1 delivery teams and Day 2 Customer Success and Support teams.
* Identify organizational gaps and improve cross-functional processes to minimize handoff issues and operational friction.

**4. Deployment and Partner Management**

* Coordinate deployment resources, including field technicians, installation partners, cabling vendors, and logistics providers.
* Ensure deployment partners meet Nile's technical, operational, and customer experience standards.
* Validate site readiness, equipment availability, shipping schedules, installation requirements, and deployment prerequisites.
* Monitor partner performance, quality of work, productivity, and adherence to deployment schedules.
* Drive corrective actions when partner performance or deployment quality falls below expectations.
* Maintain consistent deployment processes and execution standards across regions.

**5. Operational Excellence and Process Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standardized deployment methodologies, project templates, delivery playbooks, and operational procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement across project execution, customer communications, resource utilization, and deployment efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve delivery visibility through tools such as Jira and Nile's internal platforms.
* Develop scalable delivery practices that support Nile's growing customer base and global NaaS business.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, deployment records, risk registers, and customer acceptance documentation.
* Drive lessons-learned reviews and incorporate feedback into future delivery improvements.

**6. Customer Handoff and Day 2 Readiness**

* Ensure all deployment activities are completed and validated before customer handoff.
* Coordinate operational transition from Service Delivery to Customer Success, Customer Support, and Technical Account Management teams.
* Ensure customer environments are properly documented, configured, tested, and ready for ongoing operations.
* Conduct handoff meetings covering network architecture, deployment status, known issues, open actions, and operational considerations.
* Ensure outstanding deployment issues are tracked with clear ownership and resolution timelines.
* Support early-life stabilization and hypercare activities to ensure a smooth transition into steady-state operations.

**7. Reporting, Governance, and Performance Management**

* Provide regular project and portfolio updates to Service Delivery leadership.
* Maintain visibility into project health, milestones, resource requirements, risks, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for delivery execution and customer experience.
* Drive accountability across internal teams and external partners.
