new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

We are on the lookout for a dedicated and empathetic Case Manager/Mental Health Worker to assume a pivotal role in providing essential support and care to those seeking help.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for promoting Copiktra in a fair and balanced manner consistent Secura Bio’s policies. The KAM will promote Copiktra (and any other approved drugs) in a manner consistent with approved indications to targeted customers including Medical Oncologists, Hematologists and Multi-Disciplinary team. Full-time

VP, US Sales, Market Access and Operations

* Develop and execute comprehensive territory business plans that align field execution with corporate strategic objectives, drive consistent achievement of sales targets and key performance metrics. Conduct monthly business reviews to analyze progress, identify opportunities and risks, and implement data-driven adjustments to optimize results.
* Conduct face-to-face interactions at all accounts assigned to the territory.
* Achieve on-label sales growth consistently with business plans in compliance with Secura Bio policies.
* Monitor operating costs and effectively manage territory budget.

* Overnight travel within territory for face-to-face customer interactions, to conferences, training and sales meetings will be required.
* Engage with Medical Science Liaison and/or another designated contact in Medical Affairs for appropriate follow-up on customer questions.
* Comply with all Secura Bio policies and applicable laws.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Marketing, or related field
* Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PharmD, or related discipline) preferred
* Minimum 8 years of successful pharmaceutical or biotechnology sales experience
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets
* Experience calling on Medical Oncologists, Hematologists, and/or oncology practices
* Experience launching new products or promoting products in competitive markets
* Ability to understand, retain, and communicate complex clinical, efficacy, and safety data
* Strong grasp of oncology/hematology disease states and treatment paradigms
* Capability to engage in scientific discussions with highly trained medical professionals
* Strategic territory planning and business plan development experience
* Strong analytical skills to assess territory opportunities and track performance metrics
* Thorough understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulations (FDA, PhRMA Code, OIG guidelines)
* Commitment to ethical selling practices and promoting products within approved indications
* Excellent presentation and public speaking skills
* Ability to travel 50% or more to meet customers, attend conferences, training and meetings

**Territory:** **Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut**

**Salary:** $185,000 - $226,000

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Retention: healthy accounts and minimized revenue churn.
* Growth: qualified expansion pipeline and increased revenue from existing accounts.
* Adoption: increased platform utilization, resident adoption, and payment volume.
* Engagement: meaningful in-person meetings, executive relationships, and business reviews.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* 5+ years in enterprise customer success, strategic account management, or a related client-facing role.
* Track record of managing complex enterprise relationships and influencing senior executives.
* Demonstrated success driving retention, adoption, and commercial growth.
* Strong analytical, commercial, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Must be based in the Salt Lake City area and available for frequent in-person client meetings and occasional additional travel.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Multifamily housing, PropTech, FinTech, digital payments, or enterprise SaaS.
* Knowledge of property management operations, payment processing, or resident technology.
* Management of large customer portfolios with significant recurring revenue.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. We are a U.S.-led consulting practice that helps small and mid-sized business owners, for-sale-by-owner (FSBO) sellers and shopping-mall owners improve performance. Our clients hire us to turn an improvement plan into action. We need a Delivery and Implementation Specialist to work with business owners and their staff to get agreed improvements done on schedule.

**Requirements**

* At least two years of experience in operations improvement, project coordination, small-business management, retail or restaurant operations, or consulting support.

* Ability to turn an action plan into tasks, owners, deadlines and follow-ups, and to track them to completion.

* Strong written and spoken English, including video calls with business owners.

* Working knowledge of pricing, local marketing, customer service or cost-control practices used by small businesses.

* Comfort with spreadsheets, a CRM and project or task tracking tools.

* Clear, courteous communication and the ability to keep owners and their staff on track.

* Good judgment about when to escalate a question to the CEO or the analyst.

* A reliable computer and internet connection.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with each client to carry out the agreed action plan: pricing and offer changes, local marketing steps, operating and cost improvements, and tenant-mix or leasing tasks supported by our advisor.

* Break each plan into tasks with owners and deadlines, and follow up with client staff.

* Prepare weekly progress updates for clients and for the CEO.

* Record before-and-after figures and evidence supplied by the client, and pass them to the analyst for verification.

* Support quarterly client reviews.

* Document each client's changes, decisions and results in the CRM.

* Flag risks and delays promptly.

-------------------------------------

**Remote**

**Role Summary**
----------------

Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is seeking an experienced, organized, and collaborative **Sr. Payroll Operations Specialist** to support US and Canadian payroll operations within a global organization.

This role is responsible for coordinating, prioritizing, and executing payroll activities to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery. The ideal candidate understands end-to-end payroll processes, anticipates operational dependencies, and collaborates effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

The position requires hands-on payroll experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to leverage technology, AI, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
-------------------------

**Payroll Operations**

* Coordinate and execute payroll activities across multiple pay groups and processing cycles, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion.
* Manage payroll schedules, checklists, audits, reconciliations, and competing priorities.Sr.
* Support complex payroll activities, including leaves of absence, international assignees, terminations, and special payments.
* Proactively identify and resolve payroll discrepancies, operational risks, and processing delays.

**Process Coordination and Collaboration**

* Provide day-to-day operational guidance and indirect leadership to Payroll Analysts by coordinating work assignments, aligning priorities, monitoring progress, and supporting timely, accurate payroll execution without direct people-management responsibility.
* Understand upstream and downstream payroll dependencies across HR, Benefits, Leaves, Finance, and other functions.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to resolve issues and improve payroll processes.
* Partner with technical teams on system-related issues, business requirements, and user acceptance testing.

**Employee Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Manage employee payroll inquiries through case management systems, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Monitor payroll KPIs, including accuracy, timeliness, exceptions, and case resolution.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytical tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and operational workflows.
* Identify recurring issues, support root cause analysis, and implement process improvements.

**Compliance and Controls**

* Apply US and Canadian payroll regulations and established company policies.
* Execute payroll controls, audits, and reconciliations while supporting SOX compliance and audit requirements.
* Maintain accurate payroll documentation, procedures, and records.

**What We’re Looking For:**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting US and Canadian payroll operations.
* Hands-on experience with **Dayforce Payroll and Workday HCM**; Dayforce Workforce Management experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, compliance requirements, and operational dependencies.
* Experience supporting international assignees or cross-border payroll activities.
* Demonstrated ability to organize complex workflows, manage competing priorities, and meet critical deadlines.
* Experience working collaboratively within a regional payroll team in a global organization.
* Strong analytical, Excel, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience with payroll audits, case management, process improvement, and performance metrics.
* Familiarity with AI and automation tools to improve payroll efficiency and accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; CPP, PCP, or PLP certification preferred.

* Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery.
* Effective prioritization and proactive resolution of operational issues.
* Strong collaboration across regional and global teams.
* Continuous improvement in payroll accuracy, efficiency, and employee service.
* Consistent adherence to payroll controls and compliance requirements.
